notes: All 14 side measurements fall in 10.70-10.83 px/ft (median 10.77); the tracer's area-based 11.91 is about 10.6% too high. All three levels are drawn at the same scale (rooms on each level and the first-floor overall strings agree). Printed sizes were clearly readable in zoom-4 crops. Wall check was done on the overview overlay plus raw crops, so wall rectangles are approximate (+/- ~5 px) and the list is not exhaustive: many first-floor interior partitions (owner's bath, pantry/closet block, den and foyer west walls) have little or no red. The extra at the kitchen is the range/cooktop on the east kitchen wall, judged from the overview only. Also traced but arguably not house walls: four porch posts (approx 16 px squares at (213,243), (408,243), (408,320), (598,320)), the entry porch post near (538,1020), and the Bedroom 5 window well top/bottom edges around [1055,1522,48,80]. Garage door openings are untraced (correctly open).
